contexts: activity log records booked meetings only
120 hours of note reading this winter
reading: Case complexity sits upstream of both the decision to hold a meeting and the risk of readmission, so booked meetings look ineffective or harmful in crude data. The exposure that plausibly protects is a meeting the family attends that ends with a written plan, and it is visible only in notes. Carers' circumstances shape attendance, linking the exposure to deprivation and work. Trials support a modest benefit, the local question is whether it holds in routine practice.
